content:
**Scope Map**

**Preserve:** ZIP upload, project_archive extraction safety, project_storage, python_analyzer, existing `/api/projects` routes, `/api/health`, existing tests.

**Implement (my slice):**
- Backend: `/api/v1` routes for snapshots, inventory, source access, structural graph, capabilities, GitHub import, export; snapshot identity model; AnalysisRun lifecycle; CapabilityReport
- Frontend: App shell, router, design tokens, nav, workspace context, import page, file tree, map/structure view, source panel, overview, export

**Integration slots (frontend containers + typed contracts only):**
- Summaries (file/folder explanations via Watson)
- Dependencies/impact 
- Reuse/duplicates/unused (Opportunities)
- Ask Grepo
- Proposals

Now let me implement systematically. I'll work in large parallel batches.

arguments.todos:
[x] Scope map: identify preserve/implement/slot boundaries
[-] Set up .gitignore for reference material
[ ] Backend: v1 API routes (snapshots, inventory, source, graph, capabilities)

[ ] Backend: v1 models (Snapshot, FileRecord, AnalysisRun, CapabilityReport, Graph)
[ ] Backend: snapshot service and job lifecycle

[ ] Frontend: install react-router-dom and vitest

[ ] Frontend: Import page (ZIP + GitHub URL, progress, error states)
[ ] Frontend: Workspace layout with route-based navigation

[ ] Frontend: Map page (structural containment view, zoom/fit/reset, bounded SVG)
[ ] Frontend: Source panel (read-only viewer, line ranges, file identity)
[ ] Frontend: Overview page (real stats, entry points, capability chip)
[ ] Frontend: Integration slot pages (Dependencies, Opportunities, Ask, Proposals)
[ ] Frontend: Export (structural HTML export via Archify-compatible compiler)
[ ] Frontend: Workspace context (shared state: projectId, snapshotId, selectedEntity, viewState)
[ ] Integration contract tests (slot registration without editing map internals)
[ ] Backend tests pass, frontend build/typecheck pass
[ ] Write integration guide and update README
[ ] Git commit and push
